2022MNRAS.514.2614C.title: Deep radio-interferometric imaging with POLISH: DSA-2000 and weak lensing

class_details.scope: Source-Extractor false galaxies on simulated DSA-2000 skies (POLISH vs CLEAN)

execution_context.matching_criterion: Approximate false galaxies per N simulated galaxies

class_details.evidence: Source-Extractor finds approximately one false-positive galaxy per 20 simulated galaxies in CLEAN and one per 50 in POLISH (≈5% vs ≈2% false-positive incidence). No underlying source counts, completeness, thresholds, or precision–recall curve.

2025MNRAS.542.2494M.title: Strong gravitational lensing with upcoming wide-field radio surveys

class_details.scope: Cited Rezaei et al. (2022) CNN lens finder on simulated ILT data

execution_context.matching_criterion: Galaxy-scale lens recovery on simulated ILT

class_details.evidence: Cites Rezaei et al. (2022): >90% of galaxy-scale lenses recovered with a 0.008% false-positive rate on simulated ILT data (20σ; θE ≥ 3/2 beam). Not an original measurement in this paper.

2026arXiv260309162W.title: POLISH'ing the Sky: Wide-Field and High-Dynamic Range Interferometric Image Reconstruction with Application to Strong Lens Discovery

class_details.scope: SEP source detection on wide-field simulations (Table 3)

execution_context.matching_criterion: TP = ground-truth galaxy matched to a detection within a size-dependent pixel threshold

class_details.evidence: Table 3 Precision/Recall/F1: CLEAN 0.3612/0.2220/0.2750; POLISH 0.5560/0.4612/0.5042; POLISH+ 0.8744/0.5751/0.6938; POLISH++ 0.8433/0.6142/0.7107. POLISH+/++ outperform CLEAN; largest gains at low SNR.

class_details.scope: SEP shape/flux RMSE on true-positive detections (Table 3; SNR>300 plots)

execution_context.task: Shape & flux estimation on matched detections

class_details.evidence: Table 3 TP RMSE: θ_A — CLEAN 1.0046″, POLISH++ 0.4654″; θ_B — CLEAN 0.7862″, POLISH++ 0.2056″; flux — CLEAN lowest (3.2625×10⁻⁴ Jy/px) vs POLISH++ 3.1703×10⁻³ (CLEAN better absolute flux; learned methods super-resolve shapes).

class_details.unit: TPR vs Einstein radius at FPR=10⁻³
class_details.scope: CNN strong-lens finder per image type (Fig. 7)
class_details.baseline: CLEAN-trained finder; ~3×PSF-FWHM separation limit (Rezaei et al.)

execution_context.finder_method: CNN lens finder (Rezaei et al. 2022 architecture)
execution_context.matching_criterion: Lens finder trained/evaluated per reconstruction type

class_details.evidence: TPR at fixed FPR=10⁻³ vs Einstein radius (Fig. 7). CLEAN-trained finder drops below ~3×PSF-FWHM separation; POLISH/++ recover near PSF FWHM (~10× estimated DSA lens-yield gain vs CLEAN). No absolute completeness/purity beyond the curve.
